name: ChEES-R
summary: The original ChEES-rate criterion, using the squared change in the main block's centred squared radius per realised trajectory length.
note: Uses the direct gradient of the mean ChEES-rate criterion.

name: Log-ChEES-R
summary: Our log-ratio formulation, which normalises the numerator gradient by a running average of the ChEES numerator.
note: The displayed expression is the log-ratio adaptation gradient, with exponential-moving-average normalisation.

name: SNAPER
summary: Learns a difficult main-parameter direction with a metric-aware Oja update and adapts the trajectory length using squared changes along that direction per unit length.
note: The learned unit direction and the main positions use the same current mass-matrix coordinates.

name: ChEES
summary: Uses the squared change in the main block's centred squared radius, without dividing by trajectory length.
note: Cᵢ = (‖zᵢ′‖² / 2 - ‖zᵢ‖² / 2)². The current metric is applied to positions and velocities.

name: Kinetic-energy criterion
summary: Retains the package's kinetic-energy-based trajectory adaptation for comparison with the position-based criteria.
note: Uses the derivative of the main block's kinetic energy from the native sampler.
